verdict.rationale: React docs explicitly confirm server-side streaming HTML while data fetches, progressive filling before JS loads, plus hydrateRoot for hydrating server-rendered HTML on the client, directly matching the streaming-SSR-for-faster-interactivity story. React itself relies on frameworks (Next.js, React Router) to implement the full SSR pipeline, so the core capability is native but the end-to-end streaming SSR experience is delivered via ecosystem frameworks. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmarks validating time-to-interactive gains from streaming, and more detail on Suspense-driven streaming boundaries.
